design_description: A sophisticated burgundy-and-gold design focused on elegance, simplicity, and club prestige. The deep burgundy base provides a rich, traditional football identity, while the slim gold side panels create a refined athletic structure without dominating the shirt. Gold detailing on the collar, sleeves, sponsor, crest, and numbering gives the entire kit a premium, unified appearance. The clean front and uncluttered back allow the colors and proportions to carry the design, emphasizing professionalism over visual complexity. Overall, the kit feels classic, mature, and executive-level — a timeless football design where color execution and balance do all the work.
